queries_run: Carpenter Technology business model transition go-to-market change 2026

findings.claim: FY2026 10-K 描述銷售仍經自家工廠、自有配銷網路與獨立經銷商，並維持自有全球服務／配銷中心與 JIT 備貨；文件未見通路或商業模式結構轉變的描述。
findings.excerpt: Our sales are distributed directly from our production plants and distribution network as well as through independent distributors. Unlike many other specialty steel producers, we operate our own worldwide network of service and distribution centers.

findings.claim: Latrobe Distribution 報告單位因客戶下單型態下滑，FY2024 Q3 認列 $14.1M 商譽減損（全數商譽），為舊事件，非 2026 通路轉型。
findings.excerpt: We determined the goodwill associated with the Latrobe Distribution reporting unit was impaired and recorded an impairment charge of $14.1 million during the third quarter of fiscal year 2024

channel_business_model_shift.note: 搜尋未發現訂閱化／D2C／平台化或 2026 通路轉移來源；出售配銷事業的報導無法確認日期，未採用。
